description: This file defines the ClientInterface for GuzzleHttp, an HTTP client library in PHP. It specifies methods for sending HTTP requests synchronously and asynchronously, creating requests, and obtaining configuration options. The interface includes constants and method signatures that any implementing class must define, providing a contract for HTTP client behavior within Guzzle.

classes.name: ClientInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for Guzzle HTTP client implementations, including methods for sending requests both synchronously and asynchronously, creating requests, and retrieving configuration options.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send an HTTP request synchronously and obtain a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Send an HTTP request asynchronously and obtain a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Create and send an HTTP request synchronously with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Create and send an HTTP request asynchronously with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieve a configuration option for the client; deprecated in later versions.
